scope: Actual resident agentctl: exit-in-progress bounded retry on unseen workloads

rows.actions: scripted Native-parser choices; real agentctl/tool execution

method.residency: one model process; reset session only between independent tasks; no KV save/evict/restore
method.receipt: both off/on body-first then final status footer; default CLI legacy layout unchanged
method.workload: three real test.run calls plus four real Native prepare/first-greedy/actions through CLI REPL and AgentStore; fixed Native-parser tool choices;8 plain lines; actual words/iterations recorded on every row
method.order: Each case: one warmup per mode then seven evaluation repeats; rotate mode order each repeat; same command/body and tokens within case; no concurrent benchmarks/builds.
method.metrics: CLI tick wall including tools, transcript assembly, Native and numeric logs; exact post-token independent tokenizer oracle measured separately and subtracted; raw wall retained
method.excluded: model load, helper first/warm execution, per-task ordinary Native reset; no build optimization
method.process_observation: Producer main wall/process CPU and first/last flush via numeric private sidecar. End precedes sidecar write/close and OS exit; after_producer is not pure OS delay. EOF wait field eof_poll_ms includes event wait in event modes; worker queue excludes execution. Timing instrumentation common to every group.
method.policies: off disabled; on timer10ms; progress later output growth after10ms; thread owner-only. E34 *-event only changes EOF wait to lazy macOS kqueue NOTE_EXIT, preserving waitpid and timeout. Default remains on/poll. E35 off-race/progress-race add bounded1ms retries only after ESRCH or NOTE_EXIT; normal event waiting unchanged; default not switched.

limits: One M5/Metal/Qwen0.6B; real CLI/tool execution, not autonomous model planning or full output generation
Tools bounded retained4096 bytes; test.run(empty args) and verified Qwen3 template only; full render/prefix guard remains
No snapshots, evictions, disk-KV transfer, memory capacity win, cloud SSE or Windows/CUDA acceptance
No evaluation tuning; all warmup/evaluation pairs and negative results retained; per-task reset/model-resident workload only
Clock and scheduling observations cannot identify DVFS, memory-bandwidth or OS scheduler causes without counters; seven pairs do not establish p95/p99 or stable tails.
E32 lacks producer/reaping telemetry; new experiments diagnose repeatable mechanisms, not retrospectively prove the exact old 30/32ms causes.

process_semantics.cases: Both event/race: EOF-before-exit/status7; timeout/process-group no late side effects; small buffer no execution; once marker;30 immediate exits each

historical_not_rerun: Native14K and full Stream acceptance from E29; not claimed rerun here

exit_probe_note: Separate numeric syscall diagnostic, not LLM task performance; development_concurrent_build excluded; final isolated probe did not reproduce positive EOF waits in either mode.
